about: Polestar's route fixes, read by every Forge build from this checkout (never built into forge): `deliberate` holds v1's deliberate orders, the player-report fixes every route cut keeps; `overrides` holds the maintainer's hard rules (include, skip, revert, pairs). Each entry says why (`why`, or `reason` and `issue`). Check an edit with `forge data check-corrections`; docs/forge/routes.md sections 5 and 11 describe every key. $POLESTAR_ROUTE_FIXES names another file.

deliberate.about: v1's deliberate orders (player-report fixes pinned by tests/guides-reported.test.js and the guides' 'Order changes against the export' headers) as hard precedence pairs: every step of `a` comes before every step of `b` when both are in the order. Kinds: accept, task (an objective site of the quest), turnin. `group`: {q, size, why}: the group an elite or group quest wants (1 soloable elite, 2-4 a group of that many, 5 never taken) where Forever's creature data reads it wrong; the route may take it with a solo fallback (docs/forge/routes.md, Group quests).

pairs.why: Final route review, Horde 40-50 (0.3.6): 40-50/06 rides through Orgrimmar from the Grom'gol zeppelin to the flight master at about 49.6; Zilzibin Drumlore (Rise of the Silithid, 5450 XP) stands in the Drag, so the hand-in is made then, before Azshara (Loh'atu's 5535), and its experience shortens the level 50 top-up there instead of waiting for the Orgrimmar stop after Azshara.

overrides.about: Route overrides: one line each, honoured by every cut as hard constraints, shown as `override` in the skip and edit ledgers. include: {q, after: [accept|task|turnin, quest] (optional), reason, issue}: the quest is in the route (after that step when given). skip: {q, reason, issue}: never in the route. revert: {s: [accept|task|turnin, quest, task index (optional)], reason, issue} keeps that step between v1's neighbours (undoes a move); {q, edit: "drop"} keeps a quest the cut dropped; {q, edit: "insert"} undoes an insert (as skip). pairs: {a, b: [accept|task|turnin, quest], why, source}: a before b. Lines whose reason or source starts F<n> come from player reports (forge judge feedback, data/local/research/RouteFeedback.json).
